featureClaim: the explicit long-session coordinator keeps the same durable work across app restarts: binding and Task Ledger survive restart, a second workspace stays isolated, handoff/fork/compact keep working, and archive or delete invalidation plus resource reclaim prevent a stale generation from being resumed or resurrected

acceptance.criterion: at least six agent-driven real Electron/Host/Gateway journeys covering worker batch, background/UI closed, app and Gateway restart, fork/handoff/compact, revoke, archive/restore/delete and late events
at least two workspaces and one ordinary session act as isolation controls; cross-scope leaks, duplicate side effects and wrong completed/delivered claims are all 0
every journey reads back Task Ledger, transcript, owner receipts and resource state; an IPC-mock UI pass alone is not accepted as runtime wiring
OpenClaw and any available native backend are labelled with separate evidence levels; routes without real provider evidence stay fixture-only/unverified
